translation: Flavor sweet and sour, neutral, non-toxic. It mainly nourishes lung qi, thickens the intestines, supplements the bone marrow, treats palpitations and insufficiency of the five viscera, vexation below the heart, stops water below the abdomen, heat and loose stool of the small intestine, discharge of pus and blood, uterine bleeding [崩中] with leaking discharge in women, red and white discharge, and expels abscesses, deep-rooted sores, sores and hemorrhoids. Taken over a long time, it settles the heart, does not hunger, and lightens the body and prolongs life.
